title: Admin create-fast-with-dates leaves auto-derived year stale
reasoning: Fast.year is documented as auto-saved from the first fast day, but Fast.save only derives it when days already exist. create_fast_with_dates calls form.save before creating Day rows and never saves the Fast again afterward, so the auto-derived year is not applied unless the form-supplied year happened to be correct. The duplicate path handles this by setting days and then saving again, which suggests the missing save in create_fast_with_dates is unintended.
recommendation: After creating the Day rows in create_fast_with_dates, save the Fast again or set year explicitly from the first created date in the same transaction. Prefer ordering by date in Fast.save when deriving year.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included fast view tests create fasts through test factories and do not exercise the admin create_fast_with_dates workflow or assert that year is derived from created Day rows.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add an admin view test that posts first_day/last_day to create_fast_with_dates and asserts the created Fast.year equals the first day’s year.
minimumFixScope: hub/admin.py create_fast_with_dates, with an optional small hardening change in hub/models.py Fast.save to order days by date.
